items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he asked me about Tal Farlow, who was a dear friend, as you know.

ctx.x: Was there anybody that you, for instance, might enjoy listening to but wouldn’t want to play with?

Well, it’s funny. I did a telephone interview while I was still lying here about… The guy from New Mexico called me, and he was asking me about different people, and he asked me about Tal Farlow, who was a dear friend, as you know. But we played so entirely differently. We… Tal had an incredible technique and everything, and that was a dear friend. Very helpful. Gave me money when I needed it in L.A. But I don’t think we would work out too well on a record somehow. And the same with, with Pat Metheny. I had lot…
Tell us a little bit about that recording. It had some really unusual…
